source_refs.note: Homogeneity of Physical Equations: a main subheading of 1.7 Dimensions of physical quantities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 15-15.

blocks.text: Equation sahi (correct) hai ya nahi, yeh check karne ke liye dekhte hain ke equation ke dono taraf quantities ki dimensions ek jaisi hain ya nahi. Ise principle of homogeneity (dono taraf ek jaisa hone ka rule) kehte hain.
Farz karein ek car rest (ruki hui halat) se chalti hai (vᵢ = 0) aur acceleration a ke saath time t mein distance S tay karti hai. Equation of motion yeh hai:
½ jaise numerical factors (sirf number) ki koi dimension nahi hoti, is liye unhen chhor dete hain. Dono taraf dimensions rakhein:

blocks.alt: Pendulum oopar ek pivot se latakta hai. Us ke saath juda curved (mura hua) anchor hai jis ke do pallet daanton (teeth) wale escape wheel ke daanton ko pakarte hain; teer dikhata hai ke wheel clockwise ghoomta hai. Labels: anchor, pallet, escape wheel, pendulum (regulating device).
blocks.caption: The device which made the pendulum clock practical (woh device jis ne pendulum clock ko kaam ke qabil banaya) (Do You Know; kitab ki figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Dono taraf dimensions ek jaisi hain, is liye equation dimensionally correct (sahi) hai.

Escape wheel ko ghari ka spring ya weight (wazan) ghumata hai. Pendulum har jhool par anchor ko idhar udhar hilata hai; anchor ka ek pallet wheel ka ek daant chhorta hai aur doosra agla daant rok leta hai. Is tarah wheel har jhool par sirf ek daant aage barhta hai, aur pendulum ka barabar time period ghari ki speed ko control (regulate) karta hai.
